title: BladeUtils
description: A clean, all-in-one PvP texture pack with classic designs.
body:
# Clean PvP Texture Pack

A clean and classic texture pack made for many different PvP modes.
It keeps the original Minecraft style while improving visibility, reducing screen clutter, and making combat feel smoother and cleaner.


## Developed by BladeSMP

This texture pack was developed by a Minecraft SMP Network.
Join **BladeSMP.net** and experience some of the best gamemodes, including **Economy**, **FreeForAll**, **Practice**, and more!
![blade_network](https://i.postimg.cc/sXJyHFKL/0D638E28-F160-41FD-9193-EB8B5A597B11.jpg)


# Features

### BladeUtils Start Screen

The pack also includes a custom **BladeUtils start screen**, featuring the official **Blade Economy Spawn** in the background for a clean and unique menu look.
![start_screen](https://i.postimg.cc/d1B0gZnz/bladeutils-starting-screen.png)

### Animated Items

Ender Pearls and Wind Charges have custom animations to make them feel more dynamic and polished during gameplay.
![animated_items](https://i.postimg.cc/HWyZ00Zb/bladeutils-item-animations.png)


### Smaller Hand Items + Offhand

Items in your main hand and offhand are smaller, giving you a better view of your screen during fights.
![smaller_hand_&_offhand_items](https://i.postimg.cc/wj00xwMR/bladeutils-smaller-hand-offhand-items.png)



### Low Spear

The spear texture is lowered so it blocks less of your vision while playing.
![low_spear](https://i.postimg.cc/j5kX62Pb/bladeutils-low-spear.png)


### Low Shield

The shield takes up less space on your screen, making PvP cleaner and improving visibility while blocking.
![low_shield](https://i.postimg.cc/vTc0Cfbw/bladeutils-low-shield.png)


### Low Totem Pop Animation

The Totem of Undying pop animation is reduced, so it is less distracting during intense fights.
![small_totem_pop_animation](https://i.postimg.cc/sxW3sB48/bladeutils-small-totem-pop-animation.png)


### Orange Enchantment Glint

The default enchantment glint is changed to an orange style, giving enchanted items a cleaner and more unique look.
![orange_enchantment_glint](https://i.postimg.cc/6pntDGpb/bladeutils-orange-enchantment-glint.png)


### Anti Fishing Rod in Face

Fishing rods are adjusted so they do not block your face or screen as much during PvP.



### Anti Carved Pumpkin

The carved pumpkin overlay is removed, so you can wear a carved pumpkin without losing visibility.



### Low Fire

Fire is lowered both in the UI and on the ground texture, making it much easier to see while burning or fighting near fire.



### No Explosion Particles

Explosion particles are removed for End Crystals, TNT Minecarts, and more, reducing visual clutter during crystal PvP and explosive fights.
![explosion_particle](https://i.postimg.cc/4dm9v5XH/bladeutils-no-explosion-particle.png)


### Cobweb Outlines

Cobwebs have clearer outlines, making them easier to spot in combat situations.
![cobweb_outlines](https://i.postimg.cc/nhC0zvD5/bladeutils-cobweb-outlines.png)


### Orange Hearts & Netherite Armor Icons

The health hearts and netherite armor hotbar icons are changed to a clean orange style, giving the UI a more unique look while matching the overall design of the pack.
![hotbar_icons](https://i.postimg.cc/3w2j49Jk/bladeutils-hotbar-icons.png)
